# Portable, native and advanced API boundaries

[Task index](core.md) · [Core contract](../guides/core-contract.md)

Namespace membership is not a promise that every operation works on every host.
Use GameContext callbacks and embedded decoding as the ordinary portable path.

| Area | Use / ownership | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ordinary game | GameContext, read-only Input, CPU Canvas; game-owned AssetCollection/animation state | Same portable game logic in native, browser and headless hosts; optional capabilities can be absent |
| Native window | Separate `unpolished-peas-sdl3` import; Config and playGame(Game) | SDL entry point only; [compiled tutorial](../../examples/tutorial_game_protocol.zig), [source](../../src/backend/sdl_gpu.zig) |
| Native files | AssetStore roots, ActionMap save/load/attachAppData/loadAppData, Canvas writePpmFile/writePngFile | Real filesystem paths/directories; not a browser loading/save strategy |
| Portable saves | GameContext.save_data / [SaveStore](audio-save.md#core-SaveStore) | Small game-owned blobs, not paths or arbitrary file access |
| Portable asset decode | [Image/Font/Atlas/AssetCollection](assets.md) from embedded bytes | Synchronous; no implicit browser fetch, async loader or runtime-file search |
| Advanced audio | Sound/Music, AudioMixer and AudioStream | Separate owned values, explicit stream/mixer lifetimes; file loaders native-only, byte decoders portable; [audio guide](../guides/audio-assets.md) |
| Advanced graphics | Renderer2D, materials, post passes and particles | Separate staged GPU contract; no transparent replacement for Canvas or general RenderSurface GPU target; [advanced 2D](../guides/advanced-2d.md) |
| Developer replay | preview.developer InputReplay/Recorder | Preview developer tooling; explicit input/seed/selected saves, not arbitrary memory snapshots |
| Testing | [testSupport](testing.md) | Headless helpers and borrowed captures, not gameplay services |
| Debugging/tools | Inspector, profiler, diagnostics, native hot reload and packaging CLI | Opt-in tools; [developer guides](../guides/developer-tools.md), not required by a first game |

Browser WebGL2/WebGPU status and unsupported combinations are defined by the
[capability matrix](../guides/capabilities.md) and
[platform evidence](../guides/platforms.md). Successful Wasm compilation or a
CPU pixel comparison does not establish GPU parity, audio-device quality or
interactive validation on another platform.

The reference intentionally does not enumerate every advanced method. Follow
the linked contracts and source for those APIs; the ordinary authoring types,
options, fields and methods are covered in the task pages. No new subsystem
or compatibility guarantee is introduced here.
